caption_L1: Most common types of dietary changes or restrictions in Poland in 2019 is a bar plot. The y-axis plots Response while the x-axis measures Share of respondents.
caption_L2L3: The rates of dietary restrictions in the population range from around 2% to 19% of the population. The most common restrictions are low carb and low calorie diets, while the least common restriction is limiting milk intake. Most of these restrictions cluster around the 5% level, with only the top two categories exceeding 10% of the population.
